tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// skar ma'i yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ nak+ṣa tra mā tri ka nā ma dha ra ni/ bod skad du/ skar ma'i yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ drang srong skar ma la dga' bas zhus pa/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshalo*// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas kyi grong khyer chen po na/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi 'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po dang*/ gza' brgyad dang*/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa'i 'khor dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so// de nas drang srong skar ma la dga' bas stan las langs te/ thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal te/ 'di skad ces gsol to// rgyu skar mi bzad pa drag shul can sems can rnams la tshe thung zhing mdangs 'phrog pa dang*/ tshe 'phrog cing bkra mi shis pa byed pa dang*/ sems can rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba de dag mi bgyid pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can rnams la phan par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol zhes zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skar ma la dga' ba khyod kyis sems can la phan par bya ba'i phyir zhus pa legs so// ngas bshad kyis legs par nyon la yid la zung zhig /rgyu skar drag po mi bzad pa gdug pa can rnams kyis mchod pa dang bzlas brjod bzang po'i gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba ngas bshad do// de dag mchod pas lha srin gdug pa can rnams dang*/ rgyu skar drag po khros pa'i gnod pa zhi bar byed pa'i mchod pa'i rim pa bshad par bya'o// rgyu skar gyi gnas nyi shu rtsa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// gza' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// drang srong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha rnams la phyag 'tshal la lo// klu rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de rnams la phyag 'tshal ba las/

rgyu skar rnams 'di lta ste/ tha skar dang ni bra nye dang*// smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*// mgo dang lag dang nab so dang*// rgyal dang skag dang chu dang ni// gre dang dbo dang me bzhi dang*// nag pa sa ri sa ga dang*// lha mtshams dang ni snron snrubs dang*// chu stod dang ni chu smad dang*// gro bzhin dang ni mon gre dang*// mon gru dang ni khrum stod dang*/ khrum smad dang ni nam gru 'o// de rnams kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te di skad ces smra zhing 'khod do// 'di lta ste/ tsha ye sing*/ bha ye/ snar dha ye/ ma tsha ye/ hang tsha ye/ ku ra ts+tsha ye/ dza ya ye/ be ra tsa ye/ bdag cag rnams ni shar phyogs na rgyu zhing gnas pa'o zhes 'khod par gyur to// ma tshu na ya/ en tra ye/ bho ye/ tsa ra ag ye/ tra hrung ye/ ata bha ye/ a tri bha ye/ bdag cag rnams ni lho phyogs na gyu zhing gnas po'o zhes 'khod par gyur to// man tra ri ye/ man+t+ra ra ye/ snu bha sa ye/ ba yu ye/ ba sham ye/ ha de dha ye/ gho na shi ye/ bdag cag rnams ni nub phyogs na rgyu zhing gnas pa'o zhes 'khod par gyur to// pus dharma ye/ mon dre ne ra ye/ khrums wa ra ta ye/ khrums ral pu ra ye/ nam gru hu ra ye/ tha skar gu ra nam gru hu/ pra te bhe ra ye/ bdag cag rnams ni byang phyogs na rgyu zhing gnas pa'o zhes 'khod par gyur to// de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la sogs pa dang*/ drang srong skar ma la dga' ba dang*/ skar ma'i gnas nyi shu rtsa brgyad la bka' stsal pa/ gzungs sngags 'di klog pa tsam gyis skar ma'i gdon dang gnod pa kun las rab tu bsrungs nas bde ba rgya chen po 'phel bar 'gyu ro// de nas de rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu smras pa/ oṃ ra ma le ra ma le/ a dhe dha ra dh+ya/ a kā na/ bi ma le/ sarba badz+ra ra ti durna/ ma sha ma she ye/ ma ma sa pā ri sa ra sa ra/

bha dha ma swā hā/ gang zhig gzungs sngags 'di lan gcig brjod pas skar ma ngan pa'i gnod pa rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro// 'di la the tshom med do// rgyu skar ngan pa gang la yang*// skyes dang shi dang mna' sho dang*// gshin bag mkhar las gtad mnan sogs// drag po gang byas las rnams dus// gang zhig gzungs 'di brjod gyur na// de dag thams cad dge legs 'gyur// rmi lam ngan dang bkra mi shis// gnod pa kun las thar bar 'gyur// sde dpon chen po gsan du gsol// dus gsum mchod pa'i bye brag las// phyogs bzhir gtor ma brgya rtsa phul// tsho ga bzhin du rgyu skar mchod// bsrung ba dus su bstsal bar bgyi// na ma pri ta hring*/ tsa ra hring*/ sur+ya bi dha ye/ kro dha ya/ dza la dza la/ na ma ka ra dza ya/ a ṭa dza la/ pu ta pu ta/ tsa ga ṇa/ sa ra sa ra/ bi sa ra/ sarba bi sha na/ bin+dha bin+dha/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ sho dha sho dha/ nā ga ta/ sarba pra t+yaṃ gi ra hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs sngags 'di lan cig brjod pas/ lha'i gdon dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon dang*/ gdon thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro// gza' skar ngan pa dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro// stag dang dom dang*/ sbrul dang srog chags ma rungs pa rnams sgrol bar 'gyur ro// nad dang rims thams cad las srung bar byed do// lam du 'jug pa na yang bde bar 'gro zhing bde ba nyid du ldog par byed do// dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ sems rnam par g.yeng ba dang*/ dran pa nyams pa yang dran bzhin du bde bar 'gyur ro// gzungs 'di la yon tan dpag tu med par shes par bya'o// gang zhig gzungs 'di 'bri 'am 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ 'dzin tam/ mthong ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ bkur bsti byed pa de dag gi bar chad dang rkyen rnams zhi nas/ mi mthun pa'i ngan pa thams cad las grol te bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro// tshe rabs thams cad du skye ba dran par 'gyur ro// rgyu skar rnams kyang ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin du byed par 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/

oṃ bhi ha ra ni/ he ra he ra/ sa he sa ra sa he ra/ kuṇ+ḍa li/ ta ta li/ tsarta ri swā hā// zhes lan gcig brjod pas rgyu skar gyis gnod par mi 'byung ngo*// lo brgya'i bar du 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*// rgyu skar thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro// de skad ces bka' bstsal pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ rgyu skar gyi lha rnams kyis legs so legs so zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// drang srong skar ma la dga' bas zhus pa'i mdo las skar ma'i yum zhes bya ba/ skar ma ngan pa thams cad zlog par byed pa'i mdo rdzogs so/// /
